title: Completeness of certificate split search
statement: Let $C,c,m,n$ be natural numbers. If $n+C(n+1)^c=m$, then the bounded certificate split search at length $m$ returns $n$.
replaced: For natural numbers $C$, $c$, $m$ and $n$ with $n + C\,(n+1)^c = m$, the bounded search for a split position at length $m$ succeeds and returns exactly $n$.
